title: GateKeeper: Reports, Multi-Event Support, & UX/UI Refinement

ms.promise: This milestone will involve defining the user journey for the new features, including the steps that users will take to use them. An Explainer video will be created showing the user journey for the new features: Reports & Multi-Event Support, plus the new UX/UI refinements.
ms.criteria: Reviewer will view the User Journey video, it will show the user journey for the new features: Reports & Multi-Event Support, plus the new UX/UI refinements.
ms.report:
The goals for this milestone are:
This milestone will involve defining the user journey for the new features, including the steps that users will take to use them. An Explainer video will be created showing the user journey for the new features: Reports & Multi-Event Support, plus the new UX/UI refinements.

The video interview with Adam Dean shows the entire user journey as it exists today, and also shows where the new features Reporting and Multi-Event support will plug in, including a preview of the development so far on Adam’s private development machine. The entire UI is reviewed, and the locations where the designer is currently building the new UI are pointed out. This meets the goals of milestone 1.

The video is available on YouTube at the following link: https://youtu.be/5YVDMxeh--E

ms.promise: This milestone will involve designing and implementing the new user interface and user experience for the new features.
ms.criteria: Reviewer will view a Figma document. The Figma document will contain the screens for the new features, and the screens from existing features updated to the new UX/UI.
ms.report:
This milestone involved designing and implementing the new user interface and user experience for the new features. According to the evidence section "Figma Document will show new features: Reports, Multi-event Support, and enhancements to the UX/UI for the site. A Figma document is a full representation used by programmers to program applications. So what you will see is a pixel by pixel rendering of what a developer needs to use to complete the development of the new features."
This Figma document is located here:
https://www.figma.com/proto/YeLxMQ3cGd1ZZlodZtiDwJ/Gatekeeper?page-id=0%3A1&type=design&node-id=125-2&viewport=-6292%2C1358%2C2.3&t=fG1vfltitEn9FI6e-1&scaling=scale-down-width&starting-point-node-id=1%3A2&mode=design
Every screen needed for the developer to complete the development of new features is here. In addition, the entire site has a facelift with a more modern and pleasing design.

ms.promise: Sample Code Implementation (Testnet POC): This milestone will involve implementing the new features in sample code and testing them on the Cardano testnet.
ms.criteria: Reviewer will view pull request. Reviewer can view Proof of Concept Testnet version of new features at a provided URL.
